Joint venture of KIOCL
*281. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of STEEL be pleased to state:
(a) what are the names of the products
currently being manufactured by a Joint
Venture Company floated by Kudremukh
Iron Ore Co. Ltd. (KIOCL) alongwith two
other public sector undertakings in
June, 1995;
(b) the contribution to equity made by
KIOCL to Joint Venture Co. and the
reasons for non-allotment of shares;
(c) the amount of loan granted and the
interest realised; and
(d) the reasons for grant of
concessional loan and the loss caused in
interest thereof?
Expansion of area under bamboo
*282. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
announced any scheme to expand the area
under bamboo;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to
encourage State Governments to grow
bamboo in degraded lands under their
control; if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether Government propose to
give any assistance to State Governments
for this purpose; if so, the details thereof?
Improvement in GER for boys and
girls in Orissa
*283. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of children (boys and
girls separately) in age group of 6 to 14
years, who go to school in Orissa;
(b) what are the latest figures for Gross
Enrollment Ratio (GER) and dropout ratio
for boys and girls at primary level in Orissa;
and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
improve the GER especially for girls in
Orissa?

Technical Education Quality and
Improvement Programme
*284. SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
SHRI GAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are implementing a Technical Education
Quality and Improvement Programme
(TEQIP) with the help of some
international agencies; and
(b) if so, the details of the programme?
Foot and Mouth Disease Eradication
Project
*285. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any request from Andhra
Pradesh Government has been received to
include Mahboob Nagar and Nizamabad
districts in the National Programme for Foot
and Mouth Disease Eradication Project;
(b) if so, when such a request was
received; and
(c) what action Government have taken
on the request?
Vacant posts in Kendriya Vidyalayas
†*286. SHRI GHANSHYAM
CHANDRA KHARWAR: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the region-wise, subject-wise and
post-wise details of vacant posts in Kendriya
Vidyalayas as on 30th June, 2003; and
(b) by when these posts will be filled up?
Bio-farm in Orissa
*287. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it has been impressed upon
Orissa to set up a bio-farm in the State;
(b) if so, whether the State has asked
for help in the matter from the Centre; if
so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether bio-farms growing
medicinal plants, have been set up in any
of the States/areas; if so, the details thereof?
Efficiency in Railways
†*288. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a dialogue with the
Railways personnel has been held directly
to improve the efficiency in Railways and
to stop rail accidents so that the deficiencies
could be removed;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of other steps being taken
to remove the deficiencies?
Accreditation of Technical and
Educational Institutions
*289. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as per the
report of the Comptroller and Auditor
General (CAG) on the state of our

none of the 171 Institutes audited by them
could fulfil the AICTE requirements

Safety on Railways
†*290. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE:
SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have so far
implemented any important recommen-
dations on railway safety made by the
Khanna Committee and Rakesh Mohan
Committee;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(c) steps taken to implement the
recommendations of those two Committees
to prevent frequent recurrence of rail
accidents which have shown a rising trend
recently?
Purchase of DAP
*291. SHRIMATI SAROJ DUBEY:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Fertilizers Association
of India (FAI) determines the price for
import/purchase of DAP phosphoric acid
from various countries;
(b) if so, the price per ton and the
quantity of DAP phosphoric acid imported/
purchased from various countries by
the Fertilizers Association of India, during
the last three years, year-wise and
country-wise;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the FAI
also purchase/deal in the purchase/import
of these fertilizers from various countries,
separately; and
(d) if so, whether any analysis has been
made of the purchases made by FAI for
Government and for itself and if so, the
details of its findings?
Encroachments on forests
*292. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government intend to
regularise the pre-1980 encroachments on
forests by revoking the provisions of Forest
Conservation Act;
(b) whether any proposal to regularise
such encroachments has been received
from Kerala;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the area
if any, in the above category proposed to
be regularised and converted into the
Revenue land in Kerala;
(d) whether any proposal received from
the Government of Kerala for
compensatory afforestation is pending for
approval; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Retrenchment in SAIL
*293. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that SAIL has
decided to cut 10,000 jobs;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and

Allocation for education sector
†*294. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH ‘LALAN’:
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an amount
of Rs. 43,825 crores has been allotted to
education sector during Tenth Five Year
Plan;
(b) if not, the exact amount thereof;
(c) the amount-wise allocation for
development and extension of primary
education, secondary education, higher
education and commercial education out
of said amount; and
(d) the actual amount spent in each of
the above sectors during the past years of
the scheme?
Metro Project at Kolkata
*295. SHRI NILOTPAL BASU: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Metro Rail Authority of
Kolkata has released any amount to KMC
from the date of inception of Metro Project
at Kolkata for restoration of road, drainage
and sewerage system water pipe-line, street
light, parks and gardens and CRAVC from
Esplanade to Shyam Bazar Fice Point;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Reorganization of Rajkot Division
*296. SHRI LALITBHAI MEHTA:
SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Railways have received any
petition on 17th February, 2003 to consider
reorganization of Rajkot Division of
Western Railway by increasing running
kilometres, by transferring some sections
of Bhavnagar Division;
(b) whether it is a fact that the General
Manager, Western Railway, Mumbai has
vide his letter of 13th February, 2003,
addressed to the Secretary, Railway Board,
New Delhi, opined to reorganize Rajkot
and Bhavnagar Divisions and the same
demand has been made by subsequent
General Manager vide his letter of 9th May,
2003; and
(c) if so, what action has been taken to
consider reorganization of Rajkot
Division?

of students who passed B.A. Examination
from Delhi University through
correspondence course even about ten

so far;

reasons therefor; and

Infrastructures for new trains
*298. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that trains are
introduced or extended by his Ministry
without making commensurate arrangements
of supporting infrastructure in terms of
drivers, guards, TTEs and maintenance
staff; if so, the reasons therefor;

duties beyond prescribed hours;

Recommendations of Ponnaiah

SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the amount allocated to each Central
university during Ninth Five Year Plan
alongwith the amount spent by each
university;
(b) whether it is also a fact that most of
the universities have spent the funds which
were meant for educational purposes on
administrative works;
(c) what are the recommendations of
Ponnaiah Committee regarding
universities;

recommendations by universities; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?

Reducing edible oil imports
2078. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether edible oil imports are
projected to hit well over the 41 per cent
mark which reached in 2001-2002;
(b) whether edible oil imports is likely
to rise more than the last year;
(c) if so, the total edible oil imports made
during the last year;
(d) to what extent it will be more during
the current year;
(e) whether the Ministry had opposed a
reduction of duty on imported palm oil and
palmolein by the Finance Ministry; and
(f) by when the efforts would be made
to see that the production of edible oil in the
country is improved, so that imports are
reduced?
Formulating national livestock policy
2079. SHRI MOOLCHAND MEENA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether alarmed at the decline in fund
allocation for animal husbandry and fishery,
the Centre and the States have favoured quick
formulation of a National Livestock Policy
to step up investment, check cheap imports
and protect farmers' interests under WTO
regime;
(b) if so, whether the State Ministers'
Conference on animal husbandry was held
in February, 2003;
(c) if so, what were the main points
discussed; and
(d) what were the decisions taken?
Drought relief in Rajasthan through
NGOs
2080. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMAD
KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether large number of voluntary
organisations and other NGOs from foreign
countries had come to Rajasthan recently
for the distribution of drought relief to BPL
families;
(b) if so, the details in this regard
indicating the names of those foreign
voluntary organisations and NGOs who
had visited Rajasthan alongwith the places
where they had visited and the nature of
drought relief that had been distributed; and
(c) how far such drought relief had
helped to redress the problems of the drought
affected people of Rajasthan?

Depletion of livestock
†2081. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
livestock in the country is depleting
continuously;
(b) if so, whether Government are
contemplating to formulate a policy or enact
a stringent law in order to protect livestock;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Ban on use of endosulfan on
plantation crops
2082. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that endosulfan
has been classified as 'highly hazardous' to
health and banned in many countries;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
endosulfan is still being used in the
country particularly in Karnataka and
Kerala on cashew plantations and has
been linked to hundreds of cases of birth
defects, psychiatric illness, cancer etc.;
and
(c) whether Government propose to ban
the use of endosulfan on plantation crops in
the country; if so, the details thereof?
Effectiveness of Jalkumbhi compost
†2083. SHRIMATI SAROJ DUBEY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that compost made
of 'Jalkumbhi' a typical water plant is more
effective than manure for enhancing
agricultural yield;
(b) if so, whether Government are going
to take any step to promote its use; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Effect of pre-monsoon rains on kharif
crops
2084. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
SHRI R.S. GAVAI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the below normal rains in
the pre-monsoon season and the delay in
the onset of South-West monsoon had
affected sowing of early kharif cereals and
rice;
(b) if so, whether this would have any
adverse impact on production of these grains;
and
(c) if so, the likely fall in the production
of these grains?
Development of Agriculture in Arid
Zones
2085. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) what are the arid zones in various
States;
(b) the scheme presently being
implemented for the development of
agriculture in those arid zones; and
(c) the details of allocation made to
various States during the last three years for
the development of agriculture in those arid
zones?
Production and procurement of
potatoes
†2086. SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:

457
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(a) whether it is a fact that production of
potatoes is continuously increasing in the
country for last decade;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
alongwith the increase in the production of
potatoes, its cost of production is also
increasing;
(c) if so, the facts in this regard; and
(d) whether it is also a fact that due to
non-availability of proper arrangement for
marketing of potatoes, the potato growers
are facing financial crises?
Post production loss in agriculture
sector
†2087. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 25 per cent of
post production crop is assessed to be lost
in agriculture sector of the country;
(b) if not, facts in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that such loss
could be minimized with the use of advanced
technology; and
(d) if so, facts in this regard and how it
compares with loss in agriculture sector at
international level?
Assessment of benefits of Rashtriya
Krishi Bima Yojana
2088. DR. ABRAR AHMED:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have assessed
the progress and benefits of Rashtriya
Krishi Bima Yojana scheme to farmers; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Dead palms in Karnataka
2089. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) what is the estimated number of dead
palms of coconut in Karnataka due to
drought;
(b) whether Karnataka Government has
sent any proposal seeking financial
assistance to farmers for replanting;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the action, if any, taken by
Government to sanction compensation to
farmers in this regard?
Oil seeds production
2090. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
SHRI M.V. RAJA-
SEKHARAN:
DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the production
of oil seeds has declined in the year
2002-2003;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the quantum of oil seeds produced in
Karnataka during the last three years?
Stepping up of agricultural loans
2091. DR. A.R. KIDWAI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been a opinion that
agriculture loans must be stepped up where
liberalisation has opened up new
opportunities;

458
(b) if so, whether Ministry has taken up
the issue with banks to provide agricultural
loans to the farmers to make it a global
competition;
(c) whether the reluctance of commercial
banks to offer credit to agricultural sector at
lower rates has forced Government to
consider a proposal for a separate PLR for
the sector; and
(d) if so, what are the other decision
Government propose to take to provide
funds for agricultural sector to improve the
same?
Seeds Regulation Act
2092. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the fact that a faulty provision
in the Seeds Regulation Act, 1997 has
affected the interests of the farmers
throughout the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have received
any representation from the farmers to
amend the Act suitably; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Agricultural production
2093. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
formulate any policy for increasing the
Agricultural production in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether agricultural produce is being
exported/imported;
(d) if so, the item-wise details thereof;
and
(e) what steps are being taken by
Government to ban the imports of
agricultural products?
Revival of National Crop Insurance
Scheme
2094. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to revive National Crop Insurance Scheme
for increasing the participation of farmers
and making the scheme more efficient;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any proposal has been
received from Maharashtra Government in
this regard; and
(d) if so, Government's response
thereto?
Agriculture lending rate
2095. SHRI VAYALAR RAVI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Finance Minister had
agreed to give a new deal for agriculture;
(b) if so, whether this proposal of the
Finance Ministry to provide a new deal to
agriculture has not been released, so far;
(c) if so, the main programmes of action
the Ministry has decided to provide for
promotion of agriculture in the country;
(d) whether due to slow rate of private
sector investments in agriculture, the
Ministry has urged for separate agriculture
lending rate on the pattern of weaker sections
and other such categories; and

459
(e) by when a final decision in this regard
is likely to be taken?
Task force report on National Policy on
Co-operatives
2096. SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the task force appointed to
implement a National Policy on Co-
operatives has discussed the need for a single
legislation for Co-operative societies; and
(b) if so, by what time the task force is
likely to submit its report?
Encouraging agriculture on hilly land
2097. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
to encourage agriculture on hilly land in the
country where rain-fall is in abundance;
(b) if so, the details of the programmes
in the North-Eastern States;
(c) how many new varieties of crops for
the hilly area have been discovered with
details on achievements; and
(d) what would be their extent of
productivity?
Programmes of Agricultural and
Technological Universities of ICAR
2098. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the schemes/programmes of
Agricultural and Technological Universities
funded by Indian Council of Agricultural
Research and the Union Government in
Maharashtra;
(b) the details of funds allocated during
the last three years;
(c) whether there is any mechanism for
evaluating the achievements; and
(d) if so, the outcome thereof?
Assistance to H.P. from contingency
fund
2099. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Centre had decided to
release more funds from the contingency
fund to help the drought, flood, thunder,
landslide and snow affected areas of
Himachal Pradesh for relief efforts in view
of the fact the funds from the calamity relief
fund are not enough to meet its demand;
and
(b) if so, what are the details thereof?
Mission for medicinal plants
2100. SHRI R. KAMARAJ:
SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have initiated
any adhoc mission for researching medicinal
plants throughout India;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government  have taken any
measure to check exploitation by foreigners
who are visiting India in the name of
research study and importing medicinal
plants at a huge cost in the name of foreign
origin; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

460
Growth of agriculture sector
2101. SHRI ASHWANI KUMAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any meaningful growth in
the agriculture sector is expected in
2003-04; if so, what is the basis therefor;
and
(b) whether Central and State
Governments are contemplating fresh
investments in the irrigation facilities to
bring additional areas under agriculture and
whether Government is considering crop
diversification so as to make agriculture
more remunerative for farmers?
Assistance to Arunachal Pradesh
2102. SHRI NABAM REBIA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) the total amount granted to Arunachal
Pradesh for development of agricultural
sector in the State during the last three years;
(b) the total amount utilized by the State
Government against the allocated amount,
year-wise; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
ensure cent per cent  utilization of the
released amount for the purpose?
Assistance to Kerala for weils disease
of coconut trees
2103. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the amount of assistance released to
Kerala during the last year for the prevention
of weils disease affecting coconut trees;
(b) whether Kerala Government utilised
the fund allotted for the purpose;
(c) if so, the details of amount utilised
and left un-utilised by the State Government;
(d) whether Government have
discontinued the assistance due to the non-
utilisation of fund; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Shortage of fodder
2104. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is acute
shortage of fodder in the country owing to
recurrent drought condition, with details of
cattle lost directly on account of drought
and resultant loss of agricultural produce in
each State during the last three years, year-
wise; and
(b) the measures taken by Government
to replenish the fodder stock in each State
during the last three years, year-wise?
Spurious seed manufacturing
companies
2105. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of dealers/producers of
seeds whose seeds were found to be of sub-
standard quality during the last three years,
State-wise;
(b) the action taken by Government
against such dealers/producers; and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
